kdoc_ac42f082497a.content: Every InvoiceLine.TrackId must reference an existing Track.TrackId. This is the single most important consistency check on this table; a violation usually means the ETL loaded invoice lines before the track catalog finished loading.
kdoc_ac42f082497a.title: Referential integrity to Track

kdoc_b6c314dc6321.content: UnitPrice is in USD and should always be positive; the catalog has used 0.99 and 1.99 historically, so treat 0 or negative prices as a data error, not a valid tier.
kdoc_b6c314dc6321.title: Pricing

kdoc_b900595cdb12.content: Every customer row must have a valid Email; Fax and Company are legacy fields and are expected to be null for most rows — do not flag them for completeness.
kdoc_b900595cdb12.title: Email is required
